Localization
Localization
Translator / Localization Specialist
Multi-Language · Remote · Contract
Remote Contract Paid

We need fluent translators to localize Two Robots: Unleashed — UI strings, in-game dialogue, menus, patch notes, and marketing copy. You'll work from a shared glossary and style guide to keep tone consistent across all markets. Native or near-native fluency required. Bonus if you can also double as a voice actor in your language.

🇰🇷 Korean 🇷🇺 Russian 🇨🇳 Chinese (Simplified) 🇪🇸 Spanish (LatAm) 🇫🇷 French 🇯🇵 Japanese 🇩🇪 German
  • Native or C2-level fluency in one or more of the listed languages
  • Comfortable with spreadsheet-based workflows and version control notes
  • Able to preserve tone — we're irreverent, not corporate
  • Bonus: prior experience localizing games, software, or interactive media
  • Bonus: familiarity with gaming culture and competitive FPS vocabulary in your language
  • Bonus: able to also voice act in your language
Compensation: Per-word rate · Negotiable based on experience Apply Now
Voice Acting
Voice Acting
Voice Actors — Multiple Languages
5 Female · 3 Male · Remote · Contract
Remote Contract Paid

We're casting 5 female and 3 male voice actors in multiple languages for in-game characters, combat callouts, and story dialogue. Professional experience is not required — we're looking for people with naturally expressive, distinctive voices who can take direction well. Sessions are fully remote; you'll record from your own setup and submit audio files. If you're also a fluent translator in your language, that's a significant bonus.

🇰🇷 Korean 🇷🇺 Russian 🇨🇳 Chinese (Simplified) 🇪🇸 Spanish (LatAm) 🇫🇷 French 🇯🇵 Japanese 🇩🇪 German
  • Native speaker of one of the listed languages
  • Expressive, natural delivery — we want it to feel real, not performed
  • Access to a quiet recording space with minimal background noise
  • Can deliver WAV or FLAC files at 48kHz / 24-bit minimum
  • Comfortable taking written direction and iterating across a few recording rounds
  • No prior professional voice acting experience needed; a short self-recorded sample is enough
  • Bonus: willing and able to double as a translator for your language
Compensation: Per-session rate · Details on inquiry Apply Now
Quality Assurance
Quality Assurance
QA Intern
Game Testing · Remote · Internship
Remote Internship Rev Share

Join the core team as a QA Intern and get hands-on experience testing a live game in active development. You'll play builds, file detailed bug reports, verify fixes, run regression tests, and help us hit polish milestones before launch. This is a real internship. You'll have a direct line to the developers and your reports will shape the final product.

Bug Reporting Regression Testing PC Gaming Steam
  • PC with specs capable of running the game at medium settings minimum
  • Able to commit at least 8–10 hours per week during active test cycles
  • Strong written English. Bug reports need to be reproducible, not just "it broke".
  • Experience with any bug tracker (Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues, or even a shared sheet) a plus
  • Genuine interest in game development. Bonus if you play competitive games regularly.
  • Portfolio or examples of past QA / testing work welcome but not required
Compensation: Unpaid · Revenue share discussed upon launch Apply Now
Art
Art
Card Artist
2D Illustration · Remote · Contract
Remote Contract Paid

We're looking for a 2D illustrator to expand the card library for Two Robots: Unleashed. Cards are a core part of the Rennova universe - each one needs to read clearly at small sizes while holding up as a full piece of art. The visual bar is set by Darihana's existing card work. We want someone who can match that energy and build on it: dynamic compositions, bold color, and a style that feels grounded in the world we're building.

2D Illustration Character Art Sci-Fi / Action Card Game Photoshop / Procreate
  • Strong portfolio in 2D character or action illustration
  • Able to work within an established visual style - not just adjacent to it
  • Comfortable with feedback rounds and iteration on tight briefs
  • Delivers clean layered files (PSD or equivalent) with full bleed at print-ready resolution
  • Bonus: experience with card game art, game UI assets, or collectible formats
  • Bonus: familiarity with the existing Rennova card set at tworobots.com/cards
Compensation: Per-card rate · Negotiable based on experience Apply Now
